valor: For as long as she can remember, Francisca has felt an inexplicable, uncontrollable aversion to belly buttons and the shapes in the world that resemble them. When therapy isn't enough to solve her cherished phobia, she turns to other methods, with no scientific basis and not recommended for anyone with the same condition.
